title: eupatorium subglabratum
intro: Eupatorium subglabratum, commonly known as Spotted Joe Pye Weed or Spotted Joe Pye, is a flowering plant species in the aster family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Eupatorium subglabratum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
